top_news.title: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
top_news.dek: Security researchers demonstrated a method using Claude to gain unauthorized access to an OpenAI employee account and sensitive GitHub repositories.
top_news.brief: The exploit highlights risks in AI-assisted social engineering. By leveraging Claude's capabilities, researchers bypassed security measures to access internal OpenAI systems, including sensitive GitHub data. The incident underscores the growing need for robust defenses against AI-driven automated attacks on corporate infrastructure.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract representation of AI security vulnerability

top_news.title: The new AgentCore runtime: Elastic, optimized, and consistently fast starts
top_news.dek: AWS introduced the AgentCore runtime for Amazon Bedrock, designed to provide elastic, memory-efficient compute for production-grade AI agents.
top_news.brief: AgentCore is a managed compute layer that automates memory reclamation and ensures consistent cold-start performance regardless of concurrency levels. It is intended to support complex, long-running agentic workflows that require reliable infrastructure without manual maintenance.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram of AWS Bedrock AgentCore architecture

top_news.title: Benchmarking LLM Inference at Scale with AIPerf
top_news.dek: NVIDIA released AIPerf, a load-testing tool designed to benchmark LLM inference performance without the bottlenecks of single-process scripts.
top_news.brief: AIPerf addresses common limitations in custom load generators, such as Python's GIL and single-process concurrency caps. It provides a standardized way to saturate inference servers and generate reliable performance metrics, helping developers avoid the pitfalls of ad-hoc benchmarking scripts.
top_news.image_alt: Performance graph showing LLM inference latency

top_news.title: Show HN: Cactus Needle 3: 8-29MB automation models can match DeepSeek V4 Flash
top_news.dek: Cactus Needle 3 offers 8-29MB foundation models optimized for edge devices, claiming performance parity with DeepSeek V4 Flash in specific tasks.
top_news.brief: Built on a Simple Attention Network, Needle 3 is designed for mobile, robotics, and microcontrollers. While sacrificing general chat capabilities, the model is optimized for tool calling and data extraction, aiming to outperform significantly larger models in resource-constrained environments.
